api_service_modules.purpose: Base API client — fetch wrapper with auth, error handling, retries
Authentication — login, logout, session check, session persistence
Project CRUD — create, list, get, update, delete
AI provider management — register, test, models, credentials
Pascal integration — scene status, editor, corrections, revisions

loading_states.strategy: Skeleton cards during initial load, progress bars during job polling, spinners on button actions

empty_states.projects: No projects yet — create your first project
empty_states.scenes: No 3D scenes — run geometry reconstruction first
empty_states.providers: No AI providers configured — add one to enable AI features

error_states.network: API unreachable — check if backend is running on port 8000
error_states.auth: Session expired — please sign in again
error_states.permission: You do not have access to this resource
